info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Edenitec Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Edenitec Syrup Catalog API enables the creation of detailed catalog entries for Edenitec Syrup products. This API allows users to define and submit specific attributes and information related to the syrup, ensuring comprehensive product representation. Ideal for retailers and distributors, this API serves as a crucial tool for inventory management and product showcasing in online platforms. Developers can integrate this API to enhance their applications with robust cataloging capabilities.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for Edenitec Syrup, including relevant properties and specifications. Ensure that all required fields are correctly completed in the request body to successfully add the details.
